name: simlease
description: Stop coding agents from fighting over the same iOS Simulator.

interface.shortDescription: Stop coding agents fighting over one Simulator
interface.longDescription: Use several coding agents on one Mac without Simulator conflicts. SimLease gives each task its own iOS Simulator, so builds, tests, and app previews don't interrupt each other.
defaultPrompt: Use SimLease before running this work on an iOS Simulator.
Show which booted iOS Simulators are currently available.
